label: rejected

evidence.V1: Top view reads as roofing courses; front, three-quarter and silhouette read as a flat slab on a beam rather than a sloped roof piece.
evidence.V2: Four long strips and a fascia board give big/medium forms, but there are no individual shingles, ridge or nail details; some hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Shingle courses are four uniform full-width strips; stiff and plank-like with no lap taper, sag or staggered tiles.
evidence.V4: Shingle strips have consistent chamfers, but the fascia board corners are near-sharp (close_eave_studio); inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Fine moire/hatched streaking covers the timber fascia face in the front, three-quarter and close_eave studio and flat renders (z-fighting or overlapping shells; 75 cross-shell overlaps); a clear visible artifact.
evidence.V6: Stone hue in two alternating values plus timber brown secondary; disciplined across colourways.
evidence.V8: Vertex colour and chamfers match, but strip shingles and the artifacted fascia are a minor mismatch with the kit finish.
evidence.V9: Studio line reasonable for a walkable slope (CollisionFidelity Default, grid-corner pivot, white colour); T1 passes on X.

artifacts: z-fighting/moire hatching across the fascia board face
dark open gap visible behind the fascia at the gable end
top_fixes: Fix the fascia overlap causing the moire (separate or merge the coincident faces)
Break the four strips into staggered individual shingles with lapped edges so it reads as a roof at 64 px
Chamfer the fascia board corners and close the gap at the gable end
